intro.title: About Petrobolos Games
intro.subtitle: We are a compact indie studio building expressive games with strong atmosphere, intentional mechanics, and platform-ready production.

mission.title: Our Mission
paragraphs: We design character-driven experiences that balance emotional storytelling with tactile, replayable systems. Every feature is scoped for quality and clarity.
From early prototypes through launch planning, our team aligns art, engineering, design, and audio around one goal: memorable worlds that play as good as they look.
